description: This file defines the InProcessGrainDirectory class, which implements the IGrainDirectory interface for in-process grain directory management in Orleans testing environment. It manages grain address registration, lookup, and unregistration, including silo status checks.

classes.name: InProcessGrainDirectory
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IGrainDirectory for in-process grain directory management, supporting registration, lookup, and unregistration of grain addresses, with silo status awareness.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain address by grain ID, returning null if not found or silo is dead.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing previous address, with silo status validation.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Overload that registers a grain address without a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address, removing it from the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregisters all grain addresses associated with specified silo addresses.
